I apologize for making changes without your approval first. Let me revert the O2 page back to how it was before.

Here's my **mockup concept** in words for you to consider:

**Option A — Hero Banner:** The climbing infographic image sits at the very top as a full-width banner (not cut off), with the "O₂ at Altitude" title and description overlaid on a subtle dark gradient at the bottom of the image. The data table and key facts remain below.

**Option B — Standalone Card:** The image appears as its own rounded card between the info header and the data table — no overlay text on it, just the image displayed cleanly at its natural aspect ratio.

**Option C — Background Accent:** The image is used as a subtle, blurred background behind the entire page, with the existing content layered on top with semi-transparent cards.

Let me revert the page first so nothing is broken, and you can tell me which direction you prefer (or suggest something else):
